proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9804 Madhya explicitly gives Nepali mā̃ and Kumaoni mu in, with irregular loss of the stop acknowledged in the article. Dotyali mā/Dangaura ma at fits this locative postposition family, with source nasal marking preserved. Exact form ma is preserved; possible intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
